summary: New people opening the repository don't know where to start: the README lists the docs but has no short 'do this first' path. Add a Quick Start section near the top of .github/agent-hub/README.md with the essential steps to get the work order workflow running in a new repository, each linking to the matching part of .github/agent-hub/docs/setup.md.
Requested by the team lead; internal documentation work, no customer involvement.

acceptance_criteria: .github/agent-hub/README.md has a Quick Start section near the top, before the Workflows table.
The Quick Start lists 4–5 steps: add the files, set up a runner, add the secrets, set up the Jira rule, and test with a manual run.
Each step links to the matching section of .github/agent-hub/docs/setup.md rather than repeating its content.
The Quick Start is under 15 lines, and no workflow or test files change.
out_of_scope: Changes to .github/agent-hub/docs/setup.md itself — it is the detailed guide the Quick Start links to.

codebase.relevance: The setup guide the steps link to.

getting_started: Read the files listed under the codebase section first.
